application.route: Notes (desktop 1440, phone 390) and the training notes panel

component: Rich text fields: where to type (surface, prompt, accessible name, save state)
explanation: CaissaTrainer Phase 2 (notes-app.md A1, A2, A3, A13; training-notes.md N1 to N3). Observed: an editable region that was an empty contenteditable with outline none, no boundary, no prompt, no accessible name (role=textbox without a label), and on the page panel's own surface step, so a first time writer could not tell where to type. Rules applied: the field or sheet sits one surface step above its ground (and see the equal surface issue); while empty it shows one short prompt drawn from an attribute so it is never written into the saved content; a visible neutral focus ring (focus-within for a composite field); an accessible name via label or aria-labelledby, and aria-describedby for the prompt while empty; click anywhere in the field writes; save state is a function of the real save cycle (idle, saving, saved, failed with a retry) in one always mounted polite status region so it is announced and does not move the layout. TENSION: CaissaTrainer doctrine U4 (a placeholder demonstrates and is never an instruction) versus a prompt such as Start writing or Write a note about this position; the owner must say whether such a prompt counts as a demonstration. Also P04 says never show a status tag such as Automatically saved when it need not be shown; a real save state that carries failure and retry is functional, an always on Saves automatically is not. Open: whether the per block optional title prompt should be withheld at rest.

classification.rationale: No principle or preset covers how an editable text region identifies itself. Gap, with a stated tension with U4 and P04 for the owner to resolve. Owner confirmation needed.
